description: This file manages FSMonitor settings in a Git repository, including configuration, remote directory checks, and mode management (IPC, hook, disabled, incompatible). It defines functions for lazy loading settings, checking remote status, and generating messages for incompatibility reasons.

classes.name: fsmonitor_settings
classes.description: Structure holding FSMonitor mode, reason, and hook path.

methods.name: check_remote
methods.description: Checks if the repository's worktree is remote and if remote FSMonitor is allowed.

methods.name: check_for_incompatible
methods.description: Determines if the repository is incompatible with FSMonitor based on remote status and OS settings.

methods.name: alloc_settings
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new fsmonitor_settings structure with default values.

methods.name: lookup_fsmonitor_settings
methods.description: Loads FSMonitor settings from configuration or environment, setting mode and hook path accordingly.

methods.name: fsm_settings__get_mode
methods.description: Returns the current FSMonitor mode for the repository.

methods.name: fsm_settings__get_hook_path
methods.description: Returns the hook path for FSMonitor if set.

methods.name: fsm_settings__set_ipc
methods.description: Sets FSMonitor mode to IPC after checking for compatibility.

methods.name: fsm_settings__set_hook
methods.description: Sets FSMonitor mode to hook with specified path after checking for compatibility.

methods.name: fsm_settings__set_incompatible
methods.description: Marks FSMonitor as incompatible with a specific reason.

methods.name: fsm_settings__get_reason
methods.description: Returns the reason for the current FSMonitor setting.

methods.name: fsm_settings__get_incompatible_msg
methods.description: Generates an explanatory message for why FSMonitor is incompatible.
